CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "development_request_histories" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "development_requests" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "issue_collections" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_integration_audits" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_integrations" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_collections" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "issues" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "repository_collections" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "comments" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "issue_id" UUID,
  "comment_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "body" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "author" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "url" TEXT DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "development_requests" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "project_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "integration_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "requester_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "participant_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "type" TEXT DEFAULT 'feature',
  "description" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "evidence" TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
  "visibility" TEXT DEFAULT 'requester',
  "origin" TEXT DEFAULT 'managed-app',
  "discussion" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "status" TEXT DEFAULT 'submitted'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "development_request_histories" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "request_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "from_status" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "to_status" TEXT DEFAULT 'submitted',
  "actor_type" TEXT DEFAULT 'system',
  "actor_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "note" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "issues" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "repository_id" UUID,
  "number" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "node_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "title" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "body" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "state" TEXT DEFAULT 'open',
  "author" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "labels" JSON DEFAULT '[]',
  "assignees" JSON DEFAULT '[]',
  "comments_count" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "last_synced_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "original_body" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "synthesis_count" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "head_ref" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "base_ref" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "merged" BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  "merged_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "mergeable" BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  "draft" BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  "additions" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "deletions" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "changed_files" INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labels" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "repository_id" UUID,
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "color" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "description" TEXT DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "project_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "project_number" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "title" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "description" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "owner" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "url" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "provider_type" TEXT DEFAULT 'github',
  "token_config_key" TEXT DEFAULT 'GITHUB_TOKEN',
  "statuses" JSON DEFAULT '[]',
  "fields" JSON DEFAULT '[]',
  "status_field_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "status_options" JSON DEFAULT '{}',
  "last_synced_at" TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_integrations" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "project_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "credential_hash" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "capabilities" JSON DEFAULT '[]',
  "status" TEXT DEFAULT 'active',
  "revoked_at" TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_integration_audits" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "integration_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "action" TEXT DEFAULT 'created',
  "note" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "issues" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "repository_id" UUID,
  "number" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "node_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "title" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "body" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "state" TEXT DEFAULT 'open',
  "author" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "labels" JSON DEFAULT '[]',
  "assignees" JSON DEFAULT '[]',
  "comments_count" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "last_synced_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "original_body" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "synthesis_count" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "head_ref" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "base_ref" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "merged" BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  "merged_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "mergeable" BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  "draft" BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  "additions" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "deletions" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "changed_files" INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "repositories" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "owner" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "full_name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "description" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "default_branch" TEXT DEFAULT 'main',
  "is_private" BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  "provider_type" TEXT DEFAULT 'github',
  "base_url" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "token_config_key" TEXT DEFAULT 'GITHUB_TOKEN',
  "last_synced_at" TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "development_request_work_links" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "request_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "work_item_type" TEXT,
  "work_item_id" TEXT,
  "canonical_status" TEXT,
  "provider_ref" TEXT,
  "metadata" TEXT,
  "last_projected_at" TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_delivery_events" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "integration_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "request_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "idempotency_key" TEXT,
  "sequence" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "type" TEXT,
  "payload" TEXT,
  "occurred_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "delivered_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "delivery_attempts" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "last_delivery_error" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preview_approvals" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,

  "request_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "preview_id" TEXT,
  "preview_url" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT,
  "decided_by_ref" TEXT,
  "reason" TEXT,

  "stale_at" TIMESTAMP
